name: capabilities-impl
description: The capability SERVICE HOST for the definitions of this repository that no provider hosts itself (`totp@1`, `sms@1`): it instantiates the Definition (`definitions/totp.ts`, `definitions/sms.ts`), declares every provider capability its sibling plugin manifests claim and provides the service under the capability name, so a provider plugin only registers a backend and a consumer only injects. Holds no backend, no key and no operator config.

config.description: The host is provider-agnostic: which providers are declared comes from the sibling plugin manifests (`core/*/workbench.plugin.json`), never from this config. Every field here is optional.

source.description: The source label reported by `providers()` for the declared providers (display metadata mirroring the core's discovery `source`).

external.description: Whether the declared providers came from an external source (display metadata mirroring the core's discovery `external`; this repository is always consumed as an EXTERNAL source).

totp.description: Host `totp@1` (set false to not provide `ctx.totp` at all).

sms.description: Host `sms@1` (set false to not provide `ctx.sms` at all).

totpProviders.description: Provider ids to ENABLE, in precedence order (the definition's `setEnabled`). Absent = every declared provider.

smsProviders.description: Provider ids to ENABLE, in precedence order (the definition's `setEnabled`). Absent = every declared provider.
